facts.fact_text: At 2.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin, together with an unspecified number of persons, arrived in Teatralnaya Square.
At 2.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin and the persons accompanying him joined the public event organised by the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia at Teatralnaya Square.
At the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia's public event at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin spoke out on the alleged illegality of the State Duma elections.

At the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia's public event at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin distributed leaflets in support of his position regarding the alleged illegality of the State Duma elections.
A police officer present at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012 ordered Mr Nagibin, and others who had arrived with him, to stop their unauthorised meeting and to leave the square.
Mr Nagibin refused to comply with the police officer's order to stop the unauthorised meeting and leave Teatralnaya Square.
At 3.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin was arrested and taken to the police station for the purposes of compiling an administrative-offence record.

On 11 April 2012, the justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don found Mr Nagibin guilty under Article 20.2 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences for holding an unauthorised public event.

The justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don fined Mr Nagibin 1,000 Russian roubles, equivalent to about 26 euros at the time of the judgment on 11 April 2012.
